landmarks: Block Out Level 76 packs a 5×7 grid with numbered blue blocks — counters '10' and '1' on top, '1' in the middle, '4' and '1' at the bottom.
The blue '10' block needs 10 exits — clear the bottom first, then work the numbered blocks upward, and finish with the heavy '10' block at the top.
The board mixes Blue, Red, Green and more.

quickTips: The '10' block is a marathon — clear the smaller numbered blocks first to build space.
Clear the bottom first to give the numbered blocks sliding room.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Clear the red and green blocks at the bottom through the right exit to open the base.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Shift the blue blocks on the left out through the left exit to open the lower-left area.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Begin clearing the numbered blue blocks in the middle through their gates — counters decrease as they exit.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Clear the blue '4' block on the left through the left exit as the middle opens.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Tackle the blue '10' block at the top — it needs 10 exits to fully clear.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with any remaining blue '1' blocks trapped in the corners.

failurePoints: Trying to clear the '10' block before the smaller numbered blocks — it needs room to slide and exit multiple times.
Clearing the top before the bottom, which leaves the lower blocks trapped with no sliding room.
